description:
Staff counter sales including cash, POS-specific channel allocation, NF525 receipt path, offline tolerance.

**Conditions of Success:**
- Staff sells from the POS UI against the box-office allocation, cash and card (fake PSP)
- Every POS receipt lands in the NF525 journal; daily Z closure covers the till
- Short network outages don't stop sales; reconciliation on reconnect

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map).

comments.body: COS defined at epic level. Not yet decomposed — US-stories are created when the owner prioritizes this epic (Gate 1), per PRD 'Capability map'.

reference.summary: ADR-025 (TKT-73): admission event model decided — redeemed stays unique, entry/exit for passes, duplicate_admit for reconciled offline conflicts; scanner durability contract (occurrence id committed before gate-open) is a binding constraint on this ticket

governingAdrs.rule: Admission vocabulary + offline reconciliation semantics; occurrence-id durability contract binds gate-side design; trace claim begins at reconciliation.
